audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[0..6].side is a blanket 'Skill' on every row while content win[0..6] and every whys[]/spikes[]/early/mid/late string say Vel'Koz wins the entire matchup (poke, W detonations, R execute, late Liandry's burn). The two layers render opposite answers to who wins each stage.
audit.why: The full layer carries the generic templated 'Skill' chart used across many even matchups, but this matchup is not even — content correctly documents Vel'Koz dominating L1 through 2+ items via poke and true damage, matching the packet's levelChart (Vel'Koz all 7 rows) and the Tricky/7/10 rating already on the page.
audit.corrected: Flipped phases[0..6].side to Vel'Koz to match win[0..6] (already Vel'Koz, so no content edit needed per the chart rule) and rewrote each phases[N].why to state the specific Vel'Koz interaction from the kit (Plasma Fission splits, Void Rift chunk, Tectonic Disruption knockup zoning, R execute channel, Liandry's scaling, late poke deficit) instead of the generic Skill-chart filler.

audit.why: Content spikes correctly key to level 2 (Q double-tap + W chunk), level 6 (R execute), first item (Liandry's/Blackfire out-DPS), and late (sustained ray + W splits still favor Vel'Koz).

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d are verbatim tradeGood/tradeBad text under unrelated titles (lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED); breakdown.cooldowns has no digit despite both champions having numeric cooldowns available.
audit.why: dosFull[1].t promises advice about devouring the all-in's focus, dontsFull[2].t promises advice about Q-ing chip instead of diving, and neither body currently delivers that; breakdown.cooldowns names Tectonic Disruption as matchup-defining but gives no actual cooldown number to plan around.
audit.corrected: Rewrote dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d to match their titles using real ability names, and added Tectonic Disruption's 12s (10s at rank 5) cooldown and R's 100/90/80s cooldown to breakdown.cooldowns.

edits.after: His Q Plasma Fission splits for chip; Deconstruction stacks true damage on contact.

edits.before: Devour threats begin: their carry's worst moment now includes a frog's stomach.
edits.after: Void Rift W now chunks the double-tap Q — walking up to ward costs real health.

edits.after: W detonations plus Q slows out-range your Tongue Lash; you eat poke every step forward.

edits.before: Zone with devour threat — the carry your Q stuns twice is the carry you eat.
edits.after: He holds the wave and stacks poke; your telegraphed W dive gets sidestepped.

edits.before: Abyssal Voyage online — your duo's roams arrive through the floor.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with intentions.

edits.before: - Vel'Koz Tectonic Disruption: matchup-defining — The knockup starts the true-damage rotation — dodge it and the research stalls. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep W Devour (ally save) banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Vel'Koz Tectonic Disruption (E): 12s cooldown, down to 10s at rank 5 — the knockup opens the true-damage rotation; dodge it and the research stalls. - His R is 100/90/80s — track it, it's the execute window. - Keep R Devour banked to save your ADC from the channel.
